pnp.help_body:
Separator chooses how the file is split into columns on Reload.

Units (mm vs mils) must match the numbers in the table. The same choice is used on Merge, Report, and PCB Preview.

Clean X/Y/R strips non-numeric junk from mapped coordinate and rotation cells. MM↔MIL rewrites X/Y as an explicit conversion (four decimal places).

debug.fonts_note: Os dois blocos são independentes. **UI principal** — moldura, combos, campos. **Tabelas de dados** — vistas em grelha e árvore (BOM/PnP, cabeçalhos). A consola **Projeto** usa sempre JetBrains Mono ou um monoespaçado do sistema. Obter fontes: `tools/fetch_inter.py` (Inter), `tools/fetch_jetbrains_mono.py` (Mono).

mapping.pn_join_help: PN join é só para Clean BOM: as colunas são concatenadas com o nome PN (ordem da tabela) numa linha antes do Convert. Merge e o relatório não usam Join — usam o nome PN ou a primeira coluna PN.
merge.help_body:
Merge junta BOM e PnP pelos mapeamentos de colunas nesses separadores (REF, X, Y, Layer, value/PN).

Mapeie primeiro as colunas em BOM e PnP. As unidades XY (mm/mil) devem coincidir com os números na tabela PnP; a mesma escolha vale em PnP e PCB Preview.

Delete DNP remove refs extra do PnP e DNP / DNP_FROM_BOM. Replace PNP substitui o separador PnP pela tabela Merge. Find package preenche Package a partir do catálogo VSPD.

clean.watt_from_pack_tip: Se faltar watt, preencher pelo tamanho (0402→1/16W). Desligado por padrão.
clean.help_body:
Uses BOM columns mapped to PN name and/or PN join (concatenated in table order when there are two or more).

1. Import — copy raw values into the preview.
2. Convert — run classifiers and formatting.
3. Apply — write cleaned values back to the BOM (PN name on the comment column).

Join is Clean-only. Merge and the report use PN name. Everyday settings are under Settings. Pipeline debug is in Advanced.
clean.advanced_debug_tip: Pipeline steps and components library path.
clean.from_db_tip: Look up learned components from the local library. Override the file path in Advanced (pipeline debug).
clean.from_machine_tip: Match BOM text to names from the Machine lib tab. Load a library there first; unmatched rows fall through to other rules.
clean.pn_tip: Decode vendor part numbers. Pipeline order is set in Advanced.
clean.pn_vendor_tip: When Part numbers is on, this only changes the Source column label (vendor vs pn).
clean.prefix_spacer_tip: On: prefix C + spacer + 0402-12PF. Off: C0402-12PF.
clean.double_comment_tip: Merge every BOM column mapped to Comment into one line. Needs two or more Comment mappings.

clean.regex_master_scores_tip: Requires parser arbiter. Adds Arbiter and Win% columns and tints Cleaned cells by score.
clean.partial_match_tip: When machine library lookup is on, try a fuzzy match if the exact name is missing.
clean.resistor_tip: Off: resistor formatting is skipped for classified resistor rows.
clean.capacitor_tip: Off: capacitor formatting is skipped for classified capacitor rows.
clean.ohm_r_tip: Keep a trailing R on plain ohm values (12.5R). Does not change K/M suffixes.
clean.cap_uf_micro_tip: Show microfarads with µF instead of uF.
clean.btn_import_tip: Read BOM columns mapped to PN name and/or PN join into the preview.

clean.btn_apply_tip: Write cleaned values to the BOM (extra columns, or replace the source column).
clean.replace_source_tip: On: write Cleaned into the source Comment column. Off: add *_cleaned and clean_* columns.
clean.btn_learn_tip: Append the selected OTHER row to the component library.
pcb.gerber_units_help_body:
Gerber units map a loaded layer onto the millimetre scene grid used by PnP.

Auto: backends already convert Gerber to millimetres. The file header (%MOMM% / %MOIN%) is only a hint.

mm, mil, and inch apply an extra scale if coordinates were left in those units (mil × 0.0254, inch × 25.4).

CAM350 and Allegro .art files often omit an explicit D01 (draw) after a coordinate. That is not a load error: gerbonara treats those implicit coordinates as D01 and parses the file anyway.
